scope: All 84 selected upgrades. Source fields are unchanged from the original review comparison; final clue fields come from the frozen reviewed catalog.

records.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
records.upgrade: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
records.effectBeforeReview: After using a mobility spell, the next attack within five seconds burns extra maximum mana and temporarily prevents mana gain.
records.effectAfterReview: After using a mobility spell, the next attack within five seconds burns extra maximum mana and temporarily prevents mana gain.

records.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
records.upgrade: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
notes: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
records.effectBeforeReview: The passive counter loses its cooldown, advances on the caster's own attacks, and applies stacking outgoing attack-damage reduction.
records.effectAfterReview: The passive counter loses its cooldown, advances on the caster's attacks, and reduces affected enemies' attack damage against the caster.

records.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
records.upgrade: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates two fragile, uncontrollable illusions that channel the same disable. Their damage does not stack.
records.effectAfterReview: Creates two fragile, uncontrollable illusions that channel the same disable. Their damage does not stack.

records.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
records.effectBeforeReview: Slides in a direction, leaving a projectile-disjointing clone that shatters into an area disable when damaged or timed out.
records.effectAfterReview: Slides away, disjointing incoming projectiles and leaving a clone that shatters into an area disable when damaged or expired.

records.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates an icy hill that knocks enemies away and grants high-ground bonuses, flying vision, and extra ranged attack range.
records.effectAfterReview: Creates an icy hill that knocks enemies away, grants flying vision, and increases the attack range of ranged allies.

records.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
records.upgrade: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
notes: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
records.effectBeforeReview: Casting another ability releases a shorter stun along an existing terrain barrier.
records.effectAfterReview: Casting another ability releases a shorter stun along an existing terrain barrier.

records.desc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
records.upgrade: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
notes: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
records.effectBeforeReview: The projectile calls down additional area damage along its flight path and a weaker second burst on impact.
records.effectAfterReview: The projectile calls down additional area damage along its flight path and a weaker second burst on impact.

records.desc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
records.upgrade: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
notes: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates a strong illusion of a target hero that can cast basic abilities; recasting swaps the caster into its position.
records.effectAfterReview: Alt-cast creates a strong illusion of a target hero that can cast basic abilities; toggling again replaces it with the caster.

records.desc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
records.upgrade: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
notes: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
records.effectBeforeReview: The expanding ultimate returns to its caster, healing for all damage dealt on the way back.
records.effectAfterReview: The expanding ultimate returns to its caster, healing for all damage dealt on the way back.

records.desc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
records.upgrade: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
records.effectBeforeReview: Activating an illusion passive makes the caster invisible, grants movement speed, and leaves a duplicate image behind.
records.effectAfterReview: Activating an illusion passive makes the caster invisible, grants movement speed, and leaves a duplicate image behind.

records.desc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
records.upgrade: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
records.effectBeforeReview: All tethered enemies are attacked at 90% of the caster's attack rate, including while stunned after breaking the tether.
records.effectAfterReview: All tethered enemies are attacked at 90% of the caster's attack rate, including while stunned after breaking the tether.

records.desc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
records.upgrade:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
notes: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
records.effectBeforeReview: The hook deals bonus damage based on enemy pull distance, while hooking an ally halves its cooldown.
records.effectAfterReview: The hook deals bonus damage based on enemy pull distance, while hooking an ally halves its cooldown.

records.desc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
records.upgrade: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
notes: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
records.effectBeforeReview: The storm strikes two targets at once and can damage towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
records.effectAfterReview: The storm strikes two targets at once and can damage towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

records.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
records.upgrade: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.
notes: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
records.effectBeforeReview: Activating the attack passive grants the caster and nearby allies three empowered attacks plus bonus attack speed.
records.effectAfterReview: Activating the attack passive grants the caster and nearby allies three empowered attacks plus bonus attack speed.

records.desc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
records.upgrade: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
records.effectBeforeReview: The projectile gains cast range and a basic dispel; alt-cast adds damage and carries the caster alongside it.
records.effectAfterReview: The projectile gains cast range and a basic dispel; alt-cast adds damage and carries the caster alongside it.

records.desc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
records.effectBeforeReview: Channels to hurl nearby trees toward an area, applying the caster's attacks and tree-throw bonuses.
records.effectAfterReview: Channels to hurl nearby trees toward an area, applying the caster's attacks and tree-throw bonuses.

records.desc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
records.upgrade:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
notes: Break disables the damage aura.
records.effectBeforeReview: Death creates a full-damage spell-casting illusion; respawning while it survives moves the hero to the illusion.
records.effectAfterReview: Death creates a full-damage spell-casting illusion; respawning while it survives moves the hero to the illusion.

records.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates a vector-targeted wind that pushes every enemy in its area toward the chosen direction.
records.effectAfterReview: Creates a vector-targeted wind that pushes every enemy in its area toward the chosen direction.

records.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates a global-range storm cloud that repeatedly casts a lightning spell on nearby enemies.
records.effectAfterReview: Creates a global-range storm cloud that repeatedly casts a lightning spell on nearby enemies.

records.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
records.upgrade: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
notes: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.
records.effectBeforeReview: The ultimate summons two ships in sequence, each firing cannonball waves from both sides for partial damage.
records.effectAfterReview: The ultimate summons two ships in sequence, each firing cannonball waves from both sides for partial damage.

records.desc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
records.effectBeforeReview: Grants unobstructed movement, spell amplification, magic resistance, and maximum stacks of an attack-speed passive.
records.effectAfterReview: Grants unobstructed movement, spell amplification, magic resistance, and maximum stacks of an attack-speed passive.

records.desc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.

Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
records.upgrade: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
notes: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
records.effectBeforeReview: The channel affects two additional enemies, gains break distance, and grants debuff immunity with magic resistance.
records.effectAfterReview: The channel affects two additional enemies, gains break distance, and grants debuff immunity with magic resistance.

records.desc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
records.upgrade: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
records.effectBeforeReview: The channel can target allies and friendly wards; affected units repeatedly emit radial damage around themselves.
records.effectAfterReview: The channel can target allies or summoned serpent wards, making affected units repeatedly emit radial damage without disabling allied targets.

records.desc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.
records.effectBeforeReview: Attaches a heavy anchor that leashes an enemy; four hero attacks destroy it.
records.effectAfterReview: Attaches a heavy anchor that leashes an enemy hero; four hero attacks destroy it.

records.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.
records.effectBeforeReview: Temporarily transforms the caster into a hidden, slower-attacking version of their own summoned ward.
records.effectAfterReview: Temporarily transforms the caster into a hidden, slower-attacking version of their own summoned ward.

records.desc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
records.upgrade: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
records.effectBeforeReview: The channel becomes area-targeted and allows its caster to use other abilities while channeling.
records.effectAfterReview: The channel becomes area-targeted and allows its caster to use other abilities while channeling.

records.desc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
records.upgrade: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
records.effectBeforeReview: The caster can hide inside an ally during the attack sequence, granting that ally movement speed and extending the effect.
records.effectAfterReview: The caster can hide inside an ally during the attack sequence, granting that ally movement speed and extending the effect.

records.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
records.upgrade: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.
records.effectBeforeReview: Every stun pulse creates an uncontrollable summoned unit beside the target and lasts slightly longer.
records.effectAfterReview: Each stun pulse lasts longer and creates a summoned unit beside the target; these units cannot multiply.

records.desc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.
records.effectBeforeReview: Teleports an enemy farther away, then roots them and temporarily reduces both attack and cast range.
records.effectAfterReview: Teleports an enemy farther away, then roots them and temporarily reduces both attack and cast range.

records.desc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
records.upgrade: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.
records.effectBeforeReview: Launches an area grenade that damages and disarms enemies while knocking both them and the caster backward.
records.effectAfterReview: Launches an area grenade that damages and disarms enemies while knocking both them and the caster backward.

records.desc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.
records.effectBeforeReview: Transforms the caster into a traveling healing-and-damage pulse that spreads to nearby units after reaching its target.
records.effectAfterReview: Transforms the caster into a traveling healing-and-damage pulse that spreads to nearby units after reaching its target.

records.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.
records.effectBeforeReview: Nearby controlled-unit attacks accelerate repeating drumbeats that damage enemies and heal the caster's army.
records.effectAfterReview: Nearby controlled-unit attacks accelerate repeating drumbeats that damage enemies and heal the caster's army.

records.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
records.upgrade: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
records.effectBeforeReview: A short-range teleport creates damaging, silencing bursts at both the departure and arrival points.
records.effectAfterReview: A short-range teleport creates damaging, silencing bursts at both the departure and arrival points.

records.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
records.upgrade: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
notes: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
records.effectBeforeReview: The infection lowers magic resistance, spreads with full impact damage from hero targets, and has a much shorter cooldown.
records.effectAfterReview: The infection lowers magic resistance, spreads with full impact damage from hero targets, and has a much shorter cooldown.

records.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
records.effectBeforeReview: For 1.5 seconds after landing a mobility spell, recast it to return to the previous location without reverting health.
records.effectAfterReview: For 1.5 seconds after a mobility spell, a second ability returns the caster to the previous location without changing health.

records.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
records.upgrade: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
notes: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
records.effectBeforeReview: Spells and attacks send an extra spirit through the target, dealing bonus damage before returning with healing.
records.effectAfterReview: Spells and attacks send an extra spirit through the target, dealing bonus damage before returning with healing.

records.desc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
records.effectBeforeReview: Releases blades in every direction, damaging enemies by maximum health and applying Break.
records.effectAfterReview: Releases blades in every direction, damaging enemies by maximum health and applying Break.

records.desc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
records.upgrade: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
records.effectBeforeReview: Channeling through the caster's ward refracts the effect to every enemy hero nearby at reduced strength.
records.effectAfterReview: Channeling through the caster's ward refracts the effect to every enemy hero nearby at reduced strength.

records.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
records.effectBeforeReview: Slams into an area, creates a damaging zone, and applies a defensive poison passive to nearby enemies.
records.effectAfterReview: Slams into an area, creates a damaging zone, and applies a defensive poison passive to nearby enemies.

records.desc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
records.upgrade: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
notes: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.
records.effectBeforeReview: The ultimate can follow an allied target or affect an area, while producing more beams without a per-unit limit.
records.effectAfterReview: The ultimate can follow an allied target or affect an area, while producing more beams without a per-unit limit.

records.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
records.effectBeforeReview: Ignites a ground area, dealing lingering damage over time; its cast range is shorter while the caster is melee.
records.effectAfterReview: Ignites a ground area, dealing lingering damage over time; its cast range is shorter while the caster is melee.

records.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
records.upgrade: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
notes: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
records.effectBeforeReview: The bouncing heal can target enemies, damaging them, healing nearby allies, and triggering an attack against each enemy bounce.
records.effectAfterReview: The bouncing heal can target enemies, damaging them, healing nearby allies, and making the caster attack each enemy hit.

records.desc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
records.effectBeforeReview: Grants flying movement, flying vision, and speed but prevents attacking and severely limits turning.
records.effectAfterReview: Grants flying movement, flying vision, and speed but prevents attacking and severely limits turning.

records.desc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
records.effectBeforeReview: Turns the caster and nearby enemies ethereal, slowing enemies and amplifying their incoming magic damage without penalizing the caster.
records.effectAfterReview: Turns the caster and nearby enemies ethereal; enemies move slower and take more magic damage, while the caster moves faster.

records.desc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within %range% range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within %radius% radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
records.effectBeforeReview: Curses all nearby enemy heroes, revealing them through fog and scaling damage and slow with surrounding trees.
records.effectAfterReview: Curses all nearby enemy heroes, revealing them through fog and scaling damage and slow with surrounding trees.

records.desc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
records.upgrade: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
notes: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
records.effectBeforeReview: Can enter an enemy hero, attacking from inside while gaining increased regeneration.
records.effectAfterReview: Can enter an enemy hero, attacking from inside while gaining increased regeneration.

records.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
records.upgrade: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
notes: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
records.effectBeforeReview: Affected allies leave a seven-second damaging trail that slows enemies; alt-cast disables the trail.
records.effectAfterReview: Affected allies leave a seven-second damaging trail that slows enemies; alt-cast disables the trail.

records.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
notes: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.
records.effectBeforeReview: Channels a volley of piercing arrows that apply attack modifiers and a percentage of the caster's attack damage.
records.effectAfterReview: Channels a volley of piercing arrows that apply attack modifiers and a percentage of the caster's attack damage.

records.desc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
records.upgrade: After a %recast_delay%s delay, the target is Purified again with %recast_effectiveness_pct%%% effectiveness.
records.effectBeforeReview: Repeats the targeted heal after three seconds at 65% effectiveness.
records.effectAfterReview: Repeats the targeted heal after three seconds at 65% effectiveness.

records.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.
records.effectBeforeReview: Roots one enemy and compels every nearby creep—friendly, hostile, or neutral—to attack it with bonus speed.
records.effectAfterReview: Roots one enemy and makes nearby friendly, hostile, and neutral creeps attack it with bonus movement and attack speed.

records.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
records.upgrade:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
records.effectBeforeReview: Pay health to apply a basic self-dispel, then heal for the health spent plus a bonus for every debuff removed.
records.effectAfterReview: Spends health for a basic self-dispel, then heals that amount after a delay, plus extra healing per debuff removed.

records.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
records.upgrade: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
records.effectBeforeReview: Killing an enemy hero refreshes every basic ability; the associated passive also grants more movement and attack speed.
records.effectAfterReview: Killing an enemy hero refreshes every basic ability; the associated passive also grants more movement and attack speed.

records.desc: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
records.effectBeforeReview: Places invisible web-line traps connected to existing webs; crossing heroes are rooted, revealed, and damaged over time.
records.effectAfterReview: Places invisible web-line traps connected to existing webs; crossing heroes are rooted, revealed, and damaged over time.

records.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
records.effectBeforeReview: Applies the caster's invisibility buff and all its bonuses to an ally without breaking the caster's own invisibility.
records.effectAfterReview: Applies the caster's invisibility buff and all its bonuses to an ally without breaking the caster's own invisibility.

records.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
records.upgrade: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
notes: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.
records.effectBeforeReview: Enemies crossed during the movement spell are marked, then struck by a secondary attack when the caster exits.
records.effectAfterReview: Marks enemies damaged by the movement spell, then strikes marked targets within 1200 range with a secondary attack after exiting.

records.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
records.upgrade: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
notes: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.
records.effectBeforeReview: The ground fire lasts longer, deals pure damage, and gains ice walls that heavily slow enemies crossing its edges.
records.effectAfterReview: The ground fire lasts longer, deals pure damage, and gains ice walls that heavily slow enemies crossing its edges.

records.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
records.upgrade: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
notes: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.
records.effectBeforeReview: The tether grabs its target and that target's nearest allied hero, linking the second victim to the first.
records.effectAfterReview: The tether also grabs the target's nearest allied hero within 650 range, linking the second victim to the first.

records.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
records.upgrade: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
notes: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
records.effectBeforeReview: The global heal becomes channeled; nearby allies gain debuff immunity, magic resistance, and stronger healing over time.
records.effectAfterReview: The global heal becomes channeled; nearby allies gain debuff immunity, magic resistance, and stronger healing over time.

records.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
records.upgrade: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
records.effectBeforeReview: The ultimate applies Break and also affects enemies near its target; self-cast instead affects enemies around the caster.
records.effectAfterReview: The ultimate applies Break and also affects enemies near its target; self-cast instead affects enemies around the caster.

records.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
notes: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves %break_distance% units away from the target.
records.effectBeforeReview: Redirects enemy unit-targeted spells aimed near a chosen hero onto the caster while granting magic resistance.
records.effectAfterReview: Redirects enemy heroes' unit-targeted spells from a chosen hero to the caster, who gains magic resistance.

records.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
records.upgrade: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
notes: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
records.effectBeforeReview: The tracking projectile continuously fires the caster's close-range barrage around itself after a short delay.
records.effectAfterReview: The tracking projectile continuously fires the caster's close-range barrage around itself after a short delay.

records.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
records.effectBeforeReview: Throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel plus attack speed, movement speed, and health regeneration.
records.effectAfterReview: Throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel plus attack speed, movement speed, and health regeneration.

records.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
records.upgrade: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
records.effectBeforeReview: Turns a wall spell into a vector-targeted strip that roots enemies who remain inside long enough.
records.effectAfterReview: Turns a wall spell into a vector-targeted strip that roots enemies who remain inside long enough.

records.desc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
records.upgrade: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.
records.effectBeforeReview: Prevents lethal-threshold damage, strongly dispels the caster, and grants an undispellable mana-based barrier on a long internal cooldown.
records.effectAfterReview: Prevents damage that would drop health below 20%, then applies a strong dispel and an undispellable mana-based barrier.

records.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain %lifesteal_percent%%% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within %lifesteal_range% range of each other.
notes: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.
records.effectBeforeReview: Bites an allied hero, granting transformation properties and shared lifesteal healing while the two remain near each other.
records.effectAfterReview: Bites an allied hero, granting transformation properties and shared lifesteal healing while the two remain near each other.

records.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.
records.effectBeforeReview: Continuously removes negative effects from an ally, then heals them when the duration ends.
records.effectAfterReview: Continuously removes negative effects from an ally, then heals them when the duration ends.

records.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
records.upgrade:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creating an illusion has a chance to create another; activating the ultimate also creates global illusions of allied heroes.
records.effectAfterReview: Creating a copy of the caster can produce another; activating the ultimate also creates illusions of allied heroes globally.

records.desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
records.effectBeforeReview: Burrows underground, becoming invulnerable and untargetable while restoring 25% maximum health over three seconds.
records.effectAfterReview: Burrows underground, becoming invulnerable and untargetable while restoring 25% maximum health over three seconds.

records.desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.
records.effectBeforeReview: Enchants a tree with long-lasting, invisible, unobstructed vision until the tree or hidden eye is destroyed.
records.effectAfterReview: Enchants a tree with an invisible eye, granting unobstructed vision for six minutes unless the eye or tree is destroyed.

records.desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_fireshield_aoe% area of effect to receive Fire Shield.
records.effectBeforeReview: Shields an ally from several hero attacks and launches a fireball back whenever damage is absorbed; towers are valid targets.
records.effectAfterReview: Shields an ally from several hero attacks and launches a fireball back whenever damage is absorbed; towers are valid targets.

records.desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
records.upgrade: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.
notes: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
records.effectBeforeReview: Allows an allied hero to hide inside the summoned structure, with restrictions and a stun if the structure is destroyed.
records.effectAfterReview: Allows an allied hero to hide inside the summoned structure, with restrictions and a stun if the structure is destroyed.

records.desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
records.upgrade: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
notes: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
records.effectBeforeReview: Can hold two stolen spells at once, extends cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their enhanced versions.
records.effectAfterReview: Can hold two stolen spells at once, extends cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their enhanced versions.

records.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates a kinetic wall after a short formation delay that enemies cannot cross.
records.effectAfterReview: Creates a kinetic wall after a short formation delay that enemies cannot cross.

records.desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.
records.effectBeforeReview: Digs underground in place, becoming invisible and unable to attack while gaining damage reduction and empowering several other abilities.
records.effectAfterReview: Digs underground in place, becoming invisible and unable to attack while gaining damage reduction and empowering several other abilities.

records.desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
records.upgrade: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.
records.effectBeforeReview: The projectile gains range and speed, pierces debuff immunity, and applies Break.
records.effectAfterReview: The projectile gains range and speed, pierces debuff immunity, and applies Break.

records.desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.
records.effectBeforeReview: Summons a flickering orb that alternates on and off, repeatedly drawing nearby enemies toward it.
records.effectAfterReview: Summons a flickering orb that alternates on and off, repeatedly drawing nearby enemies toward it.

records.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
records.upgrade: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.
notes: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
records.effectBeforeReview: Continuously spawns orbiting orbs that slow enemy heroes on collision and can be detonated manually.
records.effectAfterReview: Continuously spawns orbiting orbs that slow enemy heroes on collision and can be detonated manually.

records.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
records.upgrade: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
notes: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
records.effectBeforeReview: Activating the defensive passive causes an invulnerable stone form that stuns nearby enemies and restores health.
records.effectAfterReview: Activating the defensive passive causes an invulnerable stone form that stuns nearby enemies and restores health.

records.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
records.effectBeforeReview: Creates a cloud that hides all allies inside and grants them the effects of the hero's defensive ultimate.
records.effectAfterReview: Creates a cloud that hides all allies inside and grants them the effects of the hero's defensive ultimate.

records.desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.
records.effectBeforeReview: When targeted by a spell, fires a single-target projectile back at the caster that briefly turns them to stone.
records.effectAfterReview: When targeted by an enemy spell, fires a single-target projectile at that caster, briefly turning them to stone.

records.desc: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
records.effectBeforeReview: Sweeping lights reveal invisible enemies, make attacks miss, and rapidly drain the maximum health of illusions caught in the beams.
records.effectAfterReview: Sweeping lights reveal invisible enemies, cause attacks to miss, and damage illusions each second based on their maximum health.

records.desc:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
records.upgrade: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
notes: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
records.effectBeforeReview: After ricocheting, the projectile expands, pierces enemy heroes, and fears them while dealing increased damage.
records.effectAfterReview: After ricocheting, the projectile expands, pierces enemy heroes, and fears them while dealing increased damage.

records.desc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
records.upgrade: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
records.effectBeforeReview: A successful parry creates a stronger mark that adds stun duration and critical damage.
records.effectAfterReview: A successful parry creates a stronger mark that adds stun duration and critical damage.

records.desc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
records.upgrade:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.
records.effectBeforeReview: Giving a unit-targeted buff to an ally also buffs the caster; self-casts copy to the nearest allied hero.
records.effectAfterReview: Unit-targeted buffs on allied heroes also affect the caster; self-casts copy to the nearest allied hero within cast range.
